title: UVM managed memory 访存路径
summary: UVM 为同一 managed 指针维护 CPU 和 GPU 的映射。页面驻留位置可随访问需求变化；缺页时，驱动选择补建映射、调整权限或迁移页面，再恢复访问。
summary_en: UVM maintains CPU and GPU mappings for the same managed pointer. When an access faults, the driver can add a mapping, adjust permissions, or migrate the page before resuming execution.

title: PyTorch 对称内存与 GPU P2P 访问
summary: PyTorch 对称内存用 rendezvous 建立 peer 映射，让 kernel 直接读写远端缓冲区。MegaMoE 用这些映射融合通信与计算，并以同步信号协调数据就绪和缓冲区复用。
title_en: PyTorch Symmetric Memory and GPU P2P Access
summary_en: PyTorch symmetric memory establishes peer mappings through rendezvous, allowing kernels to read and write remote buffers directly. MegaMoE uses these mappings to fuse communication with computation, coordinating data readiness and buffer reuse with synchronization signals.

title: CUDA 分层与 Linux 驱动
summary: CUDA 用户态驱动经 Linux 设备接口建立 GPU 资源、映射和提交通道，GPU 执行计算与搬运。H100 实测日志展示了 API 调用与设备文件、驱动入口的对应关系。
title_en: CUDA layers and the Linux driver
summary_en: CUDA user-space drivers establish GPU resources, mappings, and submission channels through Linux device interfaces, while the GPU executes computation and transfers. H100 strace/ltrace captures connect API calls with device files and driver entry points.

title: GPU 互联的软件与驱动
summary: GPUDirect RDMA 允许网卡直接搬运已注册的 GPU 显存。CPU proxy 与 GPU 直接提交请求的路径可以使用相同的数据通路，区别在于谁构造并提交网卡请求，以及谁推进完成状态。
summary_en: GPUDirect RDMA lets a NIC transfer data directly to and from registered GPU memory. CPU proxies and GPU submission paths can use the same data path; they differ in who constructs and submits NIC requests and handles completion.

title: GPU P2P 显存访问
summary: 映射建立后，kernel 用普通 load/store 指令访问另一张 GPU 的显存。地址翻译与硬件路由将请求送往对端，数据经 NVLink 或 PCIe 传输，省去 CPU 内存中转。
summary_en: GPU P2P lets kernels access remote GPU memory with ordinary loads and stores through driver-established mappings and permissions. Address translation and hardware routing direct traffic over NVLink or PCIe without staging the payload in CPU memory.

title: PyTorch Gather 与 Scatter 的前向和反向
summary: Gather 按索引选取输入，反向将多条读取路径的梯度累加回源位置。Scatter 按索引写入目标；重复目标在覆盖时产生竞争，在 scatter_add 中按加法合并。
title_en: PyTorch Gather and Scatter: forward and backward
summary_en: Gather selects inputs by index, then accumulates gradients back along the read paths. Scatter uses indices to select write destinations: repeated destinations create competing overwrites, while scatter_add combines their contributions by addition.

title: ADB 命令手册
summary: 按命令查询 ADB 的调用格式与选项，区分主机端命令和设备端 pm／am 操作。可搜索参数说明、复制命令，并打印为离线参考，便于调试时核对具体用法。
summary_en: Look up ADB command syntax and options, including host commands and device-side pm/am operations. Search parameter descriptions, copy commands, or print the reference to check usage while debugging.

title: ADB 命令速查
summary: 79 组 ADB 示例按调试任务组织，可查找并复制所需指令。条目注明设备选择、参数替换及适用条件，便于执行 Android 设备连接、应用管理和日志排查。
summary_en: Find and copy ADB commands by debugging task. The 79 examples include device selection, parameter substitutions, and usage conditions for connecting to Android devices, managing apps, and inspecting logs.

title: 目录树生成器
summary: 用键盘或鼠标搭建目录层级，实时生成 ASCII 或 Unicode 目录树，复制到 README、文档和终端。
summary_en: Build a directory hierarchy with your keyboard or mouse, then copy an ASCII or Unicode tree into a README, document, or terminal.

title: Termux:API 命令速查
summary: 在 Termux 中调用 Android 功能时，查找对应的 Termux:API 命令、参数和权限要求。57 个命令条目附有使用示例，可按用途搜索、复制或打印。
summary_en: Look up Termux:API commands for accessing Android features from Termux, with arguments, permission requirements, and usage examples. The 57 command entries can be searched by purpose, copied, or printed.

title: 用 CUPTI 追踪 PyTorch 显存分配
summary: PyTorch 的 native caching allocator 优先复用缓存块，缓存不足时向 CUDA 申请资源。CUPTI 回调记录 API 参数和结果，可据此区分缓存复用、cudaMalloc 分配与 VMM 映射。
title_en: Tracing PyTorch memory allocation with CUPTI
summary_en: The native PyTorch caching allocator reuses cached blocks before requesting more CUDA resources. CUPTI callbacks record API arguments and results, allowing allocation traces to distinguish cache reuse, cudaMalloc allocations, and driver VMM mappings.

title: PyTorch DataLoader 工作原理
summary: 启用自动分批的多 worker DataLoader 在主进程生成 map-style 数据集的批次索引，由 worker 完成读取和组装。预取让不同批次提前并行准备，默认按任务顺序交付结果。
summary_en: With automatic batching and multiple workers, a map-style DataLoader generates batch indices in the main process and sends them to workers for reading and collation. Prefetching prepares batches concurrently ahead of consumption, with results delivered in task order by default.

title: 判别模型与生成模型
summary: 判别模型学习输入与标签的预测关系；生成式分类器学习类别先验和各类输入的分布，再推断标签。垃圾邮件的朴素贝叶斯例子展示了词语分布固定时，先验变化如何影响分类概率。
summary_en: Discriminative models learn the input-to-label prediction relationship; generative classifiers model class priors and input distributions, then infer labels. A naive Bayes spam example shows how changing priors changes class probabilities while word distributions stay fixed.

title: 短板效应可视化
summary: 在各阶段可重叠执行的理想流水线中，每项工作依次经过所有阶段，最小阶段处理能力决定吞吐上限。调整木板高度，可观察瓶颈转移，以及多个阶段同为短板时的优化收益。
summary_en: For an ideal pipeline whose stages overlap and whose items pass through every stage, the lowest stage capacity sets throughput. Adjust the barrel staves to observe bottleneck shifts and the effect of improving one of several tied bottlenecks.

title: Chrome 快捷键速查
summary: Chrome 常用快捷键，按标签页、页面浏览、文本编辑、浏览器功能和地址栏分类，提供 Windows/Linux 与 macOS 对照。
summary_en: Chrome keyboard shortcuts for tabs, navigation, text editing, browser features, and the address bar, with Windows/Linux and macOS side by side.

title: Claude Code 速查
summary: 按操作查询 Claude Code 的命令及配置写法，核对权限模式和 MCP 服务器设置。支持模糊搜索与平台快捷键切换，可打印为日常操作参考。
summary_en: Look up Claude Code commands and configuration syntax for specific tasks, including permission modes and MCP server setup. Use fuzzy search, switch platform-specific shortcuts, or print the reference for daily use.

title: Codex 指令速查
summary: 可搜索的 Codex CLI 子命令、Slash 命令和启动参数，附官方文档链接，可打印。
summary_en: Searchable Codex CLI subcommands, slash commands, and launch flags, with links to the official docs. Printable.

title: Colormap 色图速查
summary: 按连续、发散、定性和循环等类别浏览常用色图的渐变示意。
summary_en: Browse gradient approximations of sequential, diverging, qualitative, and cyclic colormaps.

title: CUPTI 表速查
summary: Nsight Systems SQLite 核心表、字段与关联关系，支持按 CPU、GPU、MIXED 和 META 筛选。
summary_en: Core Nsight Systems SQLite tables, columns, and joins, searchable and filterable by CPU, GPU, MIXED, and META.

title: Matplotlib 速查
summary: 对照 Matplotlib 的绘图代码与图例，查找图形样式、坐标轴和标注的设置方法。参考内容沿用 3.5.0 版，图例与参数速记旁提供 API 文档入口。
summary_en: Compare Matplotlib code with visual examples to find plot styles, axis settings, and annotation options. The reference retains the 3.5.0 examples and provides API links alongside diagrams and parameter reminders.

title: NVIDIA GPU 架构速查
summary: 根据 NVIDIA GPU 的芯片或产品型号查找 Compute Capability 与 CUDA 编译支持，核对目标架构对应的 sm 编号和最低 Toolkit 版本。
summary_en: Look up compute capability and CUDA compilation support by NVIDIA chip or product model. The reference maps each architecture to its sm target and the first Toolkit version with native support.

title: Typst 语法速查
summary: 文本、函数、数学公式、表格和页面设置的语法示例，配有效果预览与参数速查。
summary_en: Syntax examples and previews for text, functions, mathematics, tables, page layout, and common parameters.

title: Roofline 性能模型可视化
summary: 比较 GPU 的算力与带宽屋顶线，调整 GEMM、Batched GEMM 和 Attention 参数，观察算术强度与理论性能上限。
summary_en: Compare GPU compute and bandwidth ceilings, adjust GEMM, batched GEMM, and attention shapes, and explore arithmetic intensity and theoretical performance bounds.

title: HTTP 代理与应用配置
summary: HTTP 代理为客户端和目标服务分别建立 TCP 连接。访问 HTTPS 时，CONNECT 隧道转发端到端 TLS 数据；应用实际使用的网络库决定哪些代理设置会生效。
summary_en: An HTTP proxy maintains separate TCP connections to the client and target service. For HTTPS, a CONNECT tunnel carries end-to-end TLS traffic; the network library used by the application determines which proxy settings take effect.

title: SSH 转发与隧道
summary: SSH 端口转发把应用字节装入加密 channel，由隧道另一端连接目标服务。监听端的位置决定访问方向；远程转发让主动连出的主机通过既有 SSH 连接向远端提供本地服务。
summary_en: SSH forwarding carries application bytes through encrypted channels and opens the target connection at the other end. The listener location determines the access direction: remote forwarding lets a host expose a local service through an SSH connection it initiated.

title: VPN 与多重代理选路
summary: 应用先按代理配置选择连接端点，内核再按该端点的 IP 选路。仅 VPN 可达的内网代理请求经隧道到达代理；公网代理和直连请求是否进入 VPN，取决于系统路由。
title_en: Routing with VPNs and multiple proxies
summary_en: The application chooses a connection endpoint through its proxy rules, then the kernel routes the IP address of that endpoint. A VPN-only private proxy requires the tunnel; public proxies and direct origin connections follow system routes, which may also use the VPN.

title: VPN 原理与路由
summary: 三层 VPN 将匹配路由的 IP 包加密封装，网关解封装后继续转发。WireGuard 由系统路由导入流量，再用 AllowedIPs 选择 peer，并检查接收包的源地址。
summary_en: A layer-3 VPN encrypts and encapsulates packets selected by routing; the gateway decapsulates and forwards them. With WireGuard, system routes direct traffic into the interface, while AllowedIPs selects the destination peer and validates source addresses on received packets.

title: TorchRec Row-wise Sharding
summary: TorchRec 的 sequence embedding 按行分到各 rank，ID 请求路由到持有该行的 rank 查表。向量经 AllToAll 返回后，保存的重排映射将结果恢复为原始输入顺序。
summary_en: TorchRec shards sequence embedding tables by row and routes each ID request to the rank that owns it. Local lookups produce vectors that return through AllToAll; saved permutation mappings restore the original input order.

title: TorchRec Sparse Dist Pipeline
summary: TorchRec 提前分发下一批的 ID，为通信与当前批次的训练重叠创造条件。对需要缓存的 embedding 后端，Prefetch 版本用分发后的 ID 预先准备查表缓存，并通过 stream 依赖交接状态。
summary_en: TorchRec schedules ID distribution ahead of training so communication can overlap work on the current batch. For embedding backends that need a cache, the prefetch pipeline prepares it with distributed IDs before lookup, using stream dependencies to coordinate state handoff.

title: CUDA Graph 的 autocast 边界
summary: PyTorch v2.12.0 在 autocast 内捕获 backward 时，可能加入低精度转换并引用 warmup 缓存。将 autocast 限定在 forward 内，可保留反向图的精度路径。
summary_en: In PyTorch v2.12.0, capturing backward under autocast can add low-precision conversions and reuse cast tensors cached during warmup. Restricting autocast to forward preserves the intended precision path of the backward graph.

title: DDP AccumulateGrad 的 Stream 绑定
summary: DDP 的 Reducer 长期持有 AccumulateGrad，保留节点创建时记录的 CUDA stream。让节点在训练 stream 中创建，可使梯度累加与后续 backward 的执行环境一致。
summary_en: The DDP Reducer keeps AccumulateGrad nodes alive across iterations, preserving the CUDA stream recorded at their creation. Creating these nodes on the intended training stream keeps gradient accumulation consistent with the stream used for subsequent backward execution.

title: NVIDIA GPU 原子内存顺序
summary: 线程写入 payload 后，用 release 更新原子标志；接收方用 acquire 读到这次更新后，便能按建立的顺序读取数据。同步 scope 要覆盖双方，缓冲区复用还需确认读取完成。
summary_en: A release store publishes preceding payload writes when an acquire load observes that store and both scopes cover the participants. Reusing the buffer also requires the consumer to hand ownership back before the producer overwrites it.

title: AArch64 与 PTX 内联汇编
summary: 内联汇编用操作数约束和 clobber 向编译器描述数据依赖。指针值与它指向的内存需要分别声明；异步复制还要通过 wait 或 barrier 交付数据，周边代码才能正确使用结果。
summary_en: Inline assembly describes its data dependencies to the compiler through operand constraints and clobbers. A pointer operand and the memory it accesses need separate declarations; asynchronous copies also require waits or barriers before surrounding code can use their results.

title: QuACK RMSNorm：CuTeDSL 源码解析
summary: QuACK RMSNorm 用 CuTe layout 把行数据分给 CTA 和线程，在 FP32 中规约平方和、计算归一化系数。Residual 加法与 affine 输出可融合在同一个 kernel 中。
summary_en: QuACK RMSNorm uses CuTe layouts to assign row data to CTAs and threads, reducing squared values in FP32 to compute normalization factors. It can fuse residual addition and affine output operations into the same kernel.

title: GPU 指令发射与延迟隐藏
summary: 一个 warp 等待数据时，GPU 可以发射其他就绪 warp 的指令来隐藏延迟。同一 warp 可利用的独立工作取决于最终指令顺序，提前 load 与增加并发可能增加寄存器或共享内存用量。
title_en: GPU instruction issue and latency hiding
summary_en: When one warp waits for data, the GPU can issue instructions from other ready warps to hide latency. Independent work within a warp depends on the generated instruction order; earlier loads and additional concurrent work can increase register or shared-memory use.

title: GPU 访存路径与 Nsight Compute
summary: 读取本地显存时，global load 按线程地址合并成 32 字节 sector；允许 L1 缓存时，未命中部分继续查询 L2。跨步布局可能扩大请求覆盖量，缓存命中则影响显存流量。
title_en: GPU memory paths in Nsight Compute
summary_en: For local device memory, global loads coalesce thread addresses into 32-byte sectors. With L1 caching enabled, misses proceed through L2 toward device memory; strided layouts can spread the same useful data across more sectors, while cache hits absorb part of the traffic.

title: GPU MIO Throttle 分析
summary: MIO Throttle 是指令发射前等待 MIO 队列空位的状态。共享内存访问的指令数和 bank conflict 会改变提交需求与后端工作量，其他就绪 warp 则可能覆盖这段等待。
summary_en: MIO Throttle records a warp waiting for space in the MIO instruction queue before issuing its next instruction. Shared-memory instruction count and bank conflicts affect demand and backend work, while ready instructions from other warps may cover the wait.

title: GPU Scoreboard 与依赖跟踪
summary: Scoreboard 跟踪尚未完成的操作，让 warp 在发射依赖指令前等待所需结果。NCU 可将消费者处的等待样本沿依赖关系关联到生产者指令，帮助定位延迟来自哪些访存操作。
summary_en: The scoreboard tracks unfinished operations so a warp waits before issuing instructions that depend on their results. NCU dependency views link these waits to producer instructions, helping identify which memory operations delay execution.

title: Kernel Design Agents 与 KernelWiki
summary: KDA 先固定 kernel 的验收条件和测量口径，用候选关系与实验记录保存取舍。KernelWiki 将技术说明关联到带版本的来源，为优化假设提供依据；本地验证与测量决定候选是否采用。
summary_en: KDA fixes kernel acceptance criteria and measurement protocol, then records candidate relationships and experimental decisions. KernelWiki links techniques to versioned sources for forming optimization hypotheses; local validation and measurements determine which candidates to adopt.

title: CUDA Named Barrier 与 Occupancy
summary: Named barrier 用 ID 区分同一 CTA 内线程组的同步状态。Ready 交接保证数据写好后再读，reuse 交接确认读者离开后再覆盖；每个 block 的 barrier 用量还可能限制驻留数量。
summary_en: CUDA named barriers coordinate thread groups within a CTA using separate IDs. A ready handshake orders writes before reads, and a reuse handshake orders completed reads before overwriting; the compiled barrier allocation per block can also constrain residency.

title: Nsight Compute Warp Stall 分析
summary: Warp stall 记录等待状态；所有候选 warp 都无法发射时，scheduler 才出现空档。NCU 的 Not-issued 样本结合 SASS 依赖，可定位这些空档中的等待来源。
title_en: Warp stall analysis in Nsight Compute
summary_en: A stalled warp can coexist with useful instruction issue from other warps; an issue gap appears when no candidate can issue. Combining Not-issued samples in NCU with SASS dependencies helps locate the operations behind waits observed during those gaps.

title: GPU Occupancy 与资源约束
summary: GPU occupancy 是驻留 warp 占架构上限的比例，驻留数量受最紧的资源限制。寄存器用量降低后，共享内存可能接替成为限制项；新增 warp 提供就绪工作时，有机会隐藏更多延迟。
summary_en: GPU occupancy measures resident warps relative to the architectural maximum, with residency set by the tightest resource limit. Reducing register use can shift that limit to shared memory; additional warps can help hide latency when they supply ready work.

title: Triton JIT 特化与缓存
summary: Triton 按参数类型、constexpr 值、对齐属性和编译选项划分 kernel 变体。进程内缓存复用已加载 kernel，持久缓存复用编译产物；特化粒度决定变体数量与可用的优化信息。
summary_en: Triton forms kernel variants from argument types, constexpr values, alignment attributes, and compilation options. The process cache reuses loaded kernels, while the persistent cache reuses compiled artifacts; specialization granularity controls variant count and the static information available for optimization.

title: 组相联 Cache 与 LRU 替换
summary: 组相联 Cache 把主存 line 限定在一个 set 内，满组时插入新 line 需要替换旧 line。四路严格 LRU 模型中，五条同组 line 循环访问，会持续淘汰下一条要用的 line，产生冲突 miss。
summary_en: A set-associative cache maps each memory line to one set and chooses a victim on a miss to a full set. In a four-way strict-LRU model, cycling through five lines in one set repeatedly evicts the next line needed, causing continual conflict misses.

title: LayerNorm 反向传播与 GPU 实现
summary: LayerNorm 的输入梯度沿 feature 维规约，参数梯度则跨样本行规约。两种方向决定 kernel 的组织方式；文中的 Triton 实现先融合输入梯度与参数梯度局部和，再规约 FP32 临时缓冲区。
summary_en: LayerNorm input gradients reduce across features, while parameter gradients reduce across rows. These directions shape the GPU implementation: the examined Triton kernel fuses input gradients with parameter-gradient partial sums, then a second kernel reduces the FP32 buffers.

title: PyTorch DDP 梯度规约
summary: DDP 将参数梯度组织成 bucket，在各 bucket 的梯度就绪后发起 AllReduce，可将同步与后续反向计算重叠。默认规约得到各 rank 梯度的均值，loss reduction 和 microbatch 累积方式进一步决定最终缩放系数。
summary_en: DDP groups parameter gradients into buckets and starts AllReduce as they become ready, allowing communication to overlap with the remaining backward computation. Default reduction averages gradients across ranks; loss reduction and microbatch accumulation determine the final scaling.

title: PyTorch Autograd 反向图
summary: Autograd 在前向执行时记录反向 Node 及其梯度传播边。多个分支的梯度先按目标槽位汇合，再调用对应 Node；叶子参数通过 AccumulateGrad 把结果累加到 .grad。
summary_en: Autograd records backward nodes and gradient edges during the forward pass. Contributions from multiple branches accumulate in the gradient slots of the destination node before that node runs; AccumulateGrad adds the resulting leaf gradients to .grad.

title: LLM MoE 架构与执行
summary: Sparse MoE 为每个 token 选择少量 expert，再按路由权重合并输出，使模型容量与单 token 计算量分别扩展。多卡执行还要按 expert 归属交换 token，并将计算结果还原到原位置。
summary_en: Sparse MoE selects a small expert subset for each token and combines the outputs with routing weights, allowing model capacity and per-token compute to scale separately. Multi-GPU execution also exchanges tokens according to expert placement and restores results to their original positions.

title: SiLU 的 tanh 与 exp2 实现
summary: SiLU 的 exp2 与 tanh 形式在实数域等价，却形成不同的 GPU 指令依赖链。tanh 形式以 tanh 计算和缩放乘加替代显式的指数与倒数运算，实际速度和误差取决于生成的指令与数值精度。
summary_en: The exp2 and tanh forms of SiLU are equivalent over real numbers but produce different GPU dependency chains. The tanh form replaces explicit exponentiation and reciprocal operations with tanh, scaling, and multiply-add operations; speed and error depend on the generated instructions and dtype.

title: Codex 会话存储
summary: Codex 用 JSONL 保存会话事件，用 SQLite 管理可恢复状态；日志记录运行诊断，memory 保存供后续任务复用的摘要。排查会话恢复问题时，需要区分事件历史与状态索引的职责。
summary_en: Codex stores conversation events in JSONL and resumable state in SQLite. Logs support diagnosis, while memory holds summaries for later tasks. Distinguishing event history from state indexes helps identify which records matter when investigating session recovery.

title: PyTorch Linear 与 cuBLAS 布局
summary: 同一段矩阵存储可以同时解释为 row-major 矩阵及其 column-major 转置。PyTorch Linear 借助这一关系交换 GEMM 操作数，profiler 中的 TN、NT、NN 因而描述 cuBLAS 的视图选择。
summary_en: The same matrix buffer can represent a row-major matrix or its column-major transpose. PyTorch Linear uses this relationship to exchange GEMM operands, so the TN, NT, and NN labels in a profiler describe how cuBLAS interprets those views.

title: FP8 缩放与训练 Recipe
summary: FP8 训练用 scale 把张量映射到有限的数值范围，缩放粒度与更新时机共同影响量化误差和执行成本。MXFP8 为每 32 个值配置一个 scale，使同一张量的不同区域可以采用不同尺度。
summary_en: FP8 training uses scales to map tensors into a limited numerical range. Scale granularity and update timing affect quantization error and execution cost; MXFP8 assigns a scale to each block of 32 values so regions of the same tensor can use different scales.

title: PyTorch record_stream 与显存复用
summary: record_stream 将 Tensor 的跨 stream 使用记录交给 native caching allocator。释放 Tensor 时，allocator 在这些 stream 上记录 event，确认此前排入的工作完成后才允许显存复用。
summary_en: record_stream tells the native caching allocator which other streams use a tensor. When the tensor is freed, the allocator records events on those streams and defers memory reuse until their previously queued work has completed.

title: SWA Packing 与样本隔离
summary: 堆叠多层 SWA 后，信息会沿局部注意力连接逐层传播，感受野随层数扩大。Packed 样本需要用 document mask 或 cu_seqlens 标明边界，切断跨样本路径，才能保持各样本独立计算的语义。
summary_en: Stacking SWA layers lets information travel through successive local attention links, expanding the receptive field. Packed samples need document masks or cu_seqlens boundaries to cut cross-sample paths and preserve the semantics of processing each sample independently.

title: AOTInductor CUDA C++ 部署
summary: AOTInductor 把模型编译和 GPU kernel 生成放在离线阶段，将结果打包为 .pt2，由匹配版本的 libtorch C++ loader 加载执行。自定义算子需要同时提供编译时的形状语义和运行时的实际实现。
summary_en: AOTInductor compiles the model and generates GPU kernels offline, packaging the results in a .pt2 archive for a matching libtorch C++ loader to execute. Custom operators need both compile-time shape semantics and a runtime implementation.

title: LLM 序列混合机制
summary: 序列混合机制决定 token 之间的信息交互与推理状态规模。稀疏 attention 缩小交互范围，有状态模型用固定大小的状态表示历史；KV head 组织则描述另一层缓存结构，可以与不同计算形式组合。
summary_en: Sequence mixing determines how tokens interact and how much inference state a model retains. Sparse attention restricts interactions, while stateful models represent history in fixed-size state. KV-head organization describes a separate aspect of cache structure that can combine with different computation patterns.

title: PyTorch 共享库构建与加载
summary: PyTorch 的 Linux CUDA wheel 将算子与 Python 入口拆成多个共享库。CMake 定义构建时的链接关系，import torch 时动态加载器按 ELF 依赖解析符号；两者共同影响扩展加载行为。
summary_en: PyTorch Linux CUDA wheels split operators and the Python entry point across shared libraries. CMake defines build-time links, while the dynamic loader resolves symbols through ELF dependencies during import torch. Both relationships affect how extensions load.

title: Hopper Thread Block Cluster
summary: Hopper Thread Block Cluster 保证一组 CTA 在同一 GPC 共同驻留，为跨 block 同步提供执行前提。成员通过 DSMEM 访问彼此的 shared memory，并用 cluster barrier 协调数据的生产与消费。
summary_en: Hopper Thread Block Clusters co-schedule a group of CTAs on one GPC, providing the execution conditions for cross-block synchronization. Members access peer shared memory through DSMEM and use cluster barriers to coordinate data production and consumption.

title: Context Parallel 通信机制
summary: Context Parallel 按 token 切分长序列，逐 token 算子处理本地分片，attention 通过通信取得远端 K/V。Ring 将 K/V 分块传递，与局部 attention 交错执行，为通信与计算重叠创造条件。
summary_en: Context parallelism splits a long sequence across ranks. Tokenwise operators process local shards, while attention obtains remote K/V through communication. Ring attention passes K/V in chunks and interleaves those transfers with local attention work, creating opportunities to overlap communication and computation.

title: PyTorch Dispatcher 机制
summary: PyTorch Dispatcher 将张量属性和线程局部状态合成 DispatchKeySet，按优先级选择算子实现。Autograd 等包装层完成本层工作后缩小 key set 并继续分派，最终调用 backend kernel。
summary_en: PyTorch Dispatcher combines tensor properties and thread-local state into a DispatchKeySet, then selects an operator implementation by priority. Wrappers such as Autograd handle their own semantics, reduce the key set, and redispatch toward the backend kernel.

title: PyTorch TorchDispatchMode
summary: TorchDispatchMode 在 ATen 算子进入后端前调用 Python handler，用于追踪或改写算子语义。handler 执行期间，当前 mode 暂时移出栈，使嵌套算子调用可以继续交给下一层 mode 或常规 dispatcher。
summary_en: TorchDispatchMode invokes a Python handler before an ATen operator reaches its backend, allowing tracing or changes to operator semantics. The current mode is temporarily removed from the stack while its handler runs, so nested calls can proceed to another mode or ordinary dispatch.

title: OneTrans 与 YaMBDA 数据处理
summary: OneTrans 将 YaMBDA 行为历史编码为 S-token，将候选与用户的非序列特征编码为 NS-token，再共同送入 Transformer。金字塔结构逐层裁剪历史序列，同时保留 NS-token 用于最终预测。
summary_en: OneTrans encodes YaMBDA behavior histories as S-tokens and non-sequential candidate and user features as NS-tokens, then feeds both into the Transformer. Its pyramid structure progressively trims the history sequence while retaining NS-tokens for prediction.

title: Python 导入机制
summary: Python 用模块名索引 sys.modules，复用已经加载的模块；首次导入时再通过搜索路径定位对象。Package 身份决定子模块和相对导入的解析，因此同一份代码的启动方式会影响导入结果。
summary_en: Python indexes sys.modules by module name to reuse loaded modules, consulting search paths when a module is first imported. Package identity governs submodule and relative-import resolution, so how a program is launched can change its imports.

title: GEMM 计算强度与分块
summary: GEMM 分块通过复用已加载的矩阵元素提高计算强度。M×N 输出 tile 中，A 的每个元素可复用 N 次，B 的每个元素可复用 M 次；评估带宽瓶颈时，需要分别计算各层存储边界上的流量。
summary_en: GEMM tiling increases arithmetic intensity by reusing loaded matrix elements. Within an M-by-N output tile, each A element can be reused N times and each B element M times; bandwidth analysis needs separate traffic counts at each memory-hierarchy boundary.
